notes: Profile: mid-market SaaS powering post-purchase comms for 200+ merchants; heavily API-driven; cares about deterministic latency at scale.
Current stack: Ruby rails backend, Kafka event bus, in-house message composer. Want to replace rule-based reply generator with LLM-driven agent for returns & shipping status.
Initial asks: streaming support, function/tool calling for shipment lookup + order updates, structured JSON outputs for CRM ingestion.
SLOs: p95 end-to-end response (first usable token) target < 400ms on typical requests; streaming first-byte < 150ms; sustained concurrent sessions ~120 QPS baseline.
Peak season: Black Friday / Cyber Week expected 4-6x baseline traffic; want burst guarantees or predictable degradation policy.
POC plan agreed: 4-week Hosted API POC — week1 integration + smoke tests; week2 workload replay; week3 latency tuning (batching/cache); week4 production-like load test + report.
POC metrics to validate: p95 latency under replayed baseline; 99th percentile tail behavior during 3x and 5x burst; correctness on tool-calls (shipment lookups) >= 98%.
Demo notes 2026-02-12: showed streaming + function-calling example. CTO quote: 'Need streaming to feel live — startup time is everything.'
Security: will run Redwood security questionnaire; require SOC2 + SSO; KMS integration discussed for key management; data residency for EU merchants (subset of traffic).

Commercial: prefer usage-hosted model to start; if POC shows stable throughput/cost predictability they will consider Dedicated reservation for holiday season. Pricing sensitivity high — want clear cost per 1M tokens and burst pricing.
Open items: infosec follow-up on audit logging retention; explicit SLA for dedicated burst (min GPUs/slots or failover path); demo of Console tracing for per-route cost breakdown.
Support artifacts: Fireflies recording + transcript in Drive; sample request/response logs provided for replay (anonymized).

poc_details: Goals: validate latency SLOs, function-calling accuracy, streaming UX
Traffic profile: baseline 120 concurrent QPS; peak replay up to 600 QPS for Black Friday scenario
Success criteria: p95 <= 400ms baseline; streaming start <=150ms; tool-call accuracy >=98%; cost per thousand messages within budget target

recommended_config: Streaming: enabled with incremental tokens to frontend
Function calling: strict schema validation + retry on 5xx
Caching: prefix KV cache for order id lookups
Batching: conservative continuous batching to preserve latency SLO
Routing: primary hosted in us-east for latency; fallback to us-west / dedicated pool during bursts
